[quote=western_view;61714062][b]Massacre in Western View[/b]
August 3, 2028

Valmornian and Guhui'Bernardio troops marched into Freyn Tradion territory yesterday supported by Sallach infantry divisions that had gone in and blocked off key points that would've helped Frey Tradion evacuate. The support ships sent also blockaded incoming trade from Italian Dutch. Soon Valmornian and GB troops started to blow up buildings taking innocent civilians and FT members without hesitation. That's not to say that FT didn't fight back. Very quickly snipers with rifles from across Erene were laying down a hail of bullets with machine gunners that had anything and everything from modified AK-47s to M249s, even a M240 removed from a wrecked tank. The fight raged on and on but eventually around 100 Valmornian and GB troops managed to flank FT's defending force and reach the warehouse where most of the "generals" (they're not really generals but they do control a good portion of FT's "military") in Wessernia were stationed (note that the highest leaders were not there at the time and were most likely in Farie). The "generals", their guards, the families, and many wounded FT members were trapped in the warehouse. Very quickly Vamornians and GB members were able to infiltrate and massacre at least half of those inside the warehouse including many children. The ware house was then bombed out by Valmornia and Gb with at least 25% of those inside taking hostage (mostly "generals" and "officers"). It is estimated that 49% of those in the warehouse were killed (mostly family members and wounded) and only a small sliver were able to escape.[/quote]
[b]ONE Intervention in Western View[/b]

There are two formalized military commands within the ONE command structure. The first was the Straits Command, led by the Montfleurois Straits Commander, who was tasked largely with defensive operations. The second was the Combined Reaction Force or CRF, who served as the organization's principal power projection beyond the Eastern Straits.

In theory, any actions by the CRF had to be done as a single bloc in the Military Directorate, but until such time that ONE was able to formalize the text of the Kingsmount Declaration onto a standardized document, the CRF largely remained a theoretical body, with the ONE member states typically going it alone, as in the Wessernian Civil War, in which the states of Sallach and Montfleur simply operated on the basis of the Porcéan memoranda that called for ONE intervention, though acting separately and fielding units in phases according to what seemed expedient at the time.

Field Marshal Godfrey Haigh, the supreme Military Director of ONE, now hopes to remedy this fact in advance of Vespurias's own participation in the great intervention. Coordinating with CRF Commander Sebastian Yarick, it was agreed that all participating ONE forces had to be retroactively integrated into a new joint task force to coordinate mission objectives, the exact structure of which have been released below:

[b]Operation Hopscotch[/b]

With the combined Sallo-Montfleurois forces having succeeded in securing direct links with the Valmornian forces, the ONE Military Directorate would decide to swiftly move onto Phase II of their intervention, consisting of heavy Vespurian SEAD operations, air strikes on key strategic sites, and the amphibious lodgment of the main Vespurian response force that was to come much later, spearheaded by the IVS [i]Nemesis[/i] amphibious assault ship and her escort force.

At the moment, the pace of the conflict was now proceeding in such a way that was pleasing to military headquarters, though Field Marshal Haigh would be disappointed by reports of civilian massacres carried out by Valmornian forces, and would send several letters to their military leadership, calling for "restraint and care" in the management of the spoils of war as to avoid unwanted revolts and international scrutiny at this crucial juncture of the civil war.

In the mean time, Operation Hopscotch would go underway to swiftly knock out all rival military assets in Western View, beginning with the departure of Vespurian aircraft from the THEP bases in the Bobian Republic, principally elements of Vespurian Wing 17, which would engage in heavy jamming to flood the electromagnetic spectrum of key defensive bases held by SBM, FT, and IV forces. 

Should jamming efforts be successful, the [i]Endymion[/i] attack submarine would move towards the mountainous underbelly of Western View and launch cruise missiles to dismantle enemy fortifications and defense networks, while the [i]Nemesis[/i] would deploy its aircraft to destroy radar sites and SAMs. The Montfleurois naval screen, led by the [i]Saint-Matthieu[/i] multi-role frigate, would in the mean time prepare an inner screen in preparation for massive amphibious and paratrooper assaults, with Sallacher avisos shifting towards coastal interdiction.

[b]Military and peacekeeping intervention[/b]

-The 8th BMSK peacekeeping division will be deploy in [nation]Western View[/nation]. The main mission is protecting non-combatants and civilians in [nation]Western View[/nation] and have no more action to prevent further casualties.
